column1: # REBUILD-TARGETS.tsv: the run record and the sha256 values of each project file of the release.
# The published files went through the release write: the organisation columns and the
# pseudonyms of the identity columns, in one write, with a salt. The salt is deleted by design.
# So no one can make the published bytes again. The rebuild has three targets:
#   merge_input_sha256    the file that the run gave (merge_input = run), or the file after the
#                         trailer post-fix of the run output (merge_input = post-fix);
#   pre_pseudonym_sha256  the file after the layer merge (the metadata columns of the final
#                         sidecar, the v1 encoding): the input of the release write;
#   published_sha256      the published file. It is equal to the pre_pseudonym file in every
#                         column that the release write does not change (scripts/compare_published.py).
#   project, layer        the name of MANIFEST.tsv; v1 = 5,000 or more commits, x1k = 1,000 to 4,999.
#   run_record            proven: a run ledger record whose Parquet sha256 starts the sha256 chain
#                         to the published file; rows-only: the record has the rows of the file,
#                         but no sha256 chain (17 files of the path-fix rerun).
#   run_commit            the commit that the run checked out (the ledger pinned_sha / checked_out_sha).
#                         The runs used --latest: this is not column 6 of the S7 manifests.
#   frame_commit          the snapshot commit of the frame (column 6 of the S7 manifests).
#   cregit_commit, ctp_commit   the tool commits of the run (tools.lock).
#   merge_input           run, post-fix or unknown (see above).
#   run_sidecar           the project_meta sidecar file of the run (the ledger flag --project-meta).
#   run_meta_entry_sha256 the sha256 of the entry of the project in that file (JSON with sorted
#                         keys, no spaces, UTF-8). ctp reads only this entry. rebuild-one takes a
#                         sidecar under pipeline/s7-run with an equal entry. Empty: no unique copy
#                         of the run sidecar was found.
# Sources: the run ledgers of the dataset build, the merge reports of both layers, the report of
# the release write, the BRL-CAD kit and the SHA256SUMS of the release root dataset-release-1.
